description: This file defines a class 'ArrayInput' within the 'OrangeHRM\Framework\Console' namespace that extends Symfony's ArrayInput class. It adds a private property to store parameters and a method to retrieve them, serving as a customized input handler for console commands.

classes.name: ArrayInput
classes.description: A subclass of Symfony's ArrayInput that stores the input parameters internally and provides a method to access the raw parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayInput with provided parameters, optionally accepting an InputDefinition object, and stores the parameters internally.

methods.name: getRawParameters
methods.description: Returns the original parameters array stored during instantiation.
